name: Koda Chihaya
source: Chihaya is famous as a too beautiful cosmetic surgeon. His Japan office is said to welcome renowned actresses from all over the world, although it is not clear how much truth there is to these rumors. They say he's booked for a year thanks to his exceptional skills and refined sensibilities.
